stable.label: native-cpp-kernel-ci-pass
stable.note: The active C++/WebAssembly material kernel and WebGPU volumetric route have GitHub-hosted Codehood/Foundation evidence. Browser execution and iPhone execution remain unverified.

active_experience.runtime: from-scratch C++ compiled to WebAssembly owns material state; a JavaScript Worker transfers packed 3D state to a from-scratch WebGPU volume ray marcher; no third-party game, physics, rendering, or simulation libraries
render_coupling: 3D solid and water density come directly from native material occupancy
surface normals come from gradients of the uploaded native 3D field
water absorption/scattering consumes simulated suspended sediment
water shape comes from simulated water occupancy rather than an animated height function
approximations: water is cellular occupancy transport, not Navier-Stokes CFD and has no explicit velocity or pressure field
ray marching interpolates the discrete native field for presentation but does not increase simulation resolution
lighting, sky, tone mapping and position texture are presentation only
active native route has no native articulated creature physics
active native route has no learning/evolution system

native_volume_renderer.truth: WebGPU ray marching is presentation over native 3D state; it does not feed back into physics. Time-driven fake water-normal animation is forbidden; water normals derive from the native water-density gradient and turbidity derives from native suspended sediment.
tests: active route requires WebGPU 3D volume renderer
water normal must derive from native 3D water gradient
native sediment must reach GPU water turbidity input

active_objective: Promote the state-derived volumetric renderer only after independent branch CI, then deepen the native fluid model rather than adding cosmetic motion.
next_gate: Codehood and Foundation must pass with the new volumetric truth checks. LIVE_TESTED and DEVICE_TESTED require actual deployed browser/device execution.
next_scientific_blocker: Native water transports occupancy but has no explicit velocity, pressure, or momentum field. The next bounded physics system should add native fluid momentum/pressure state with conservation and stability tests before any CFD-like claim.
invariants: WebGPU geometry/optics must derive from native state when presented as simulation
do not call cellular water CFD
do not present interpolation or time-driven shader motion as physics
Stable vs Lab isolation must remain fail-closed
CI_PASS does not imply LIVE_TESTED or DEVICE_TESTED
